# PR #1187 — Part B, B3 round 2: re-issue after the body-only edit

This is the same gate that wrote verdict-1185 and verdict-1187. Checked 2026-10-04.

## Scope of this re-issue

verdict-1187 found the code ready to merge. Its two required changes were both body-only:
- AC-7: the report was cut off;
- AC-5: the statement that the admin steps are the Operator's was missing.

The head is unchanged at `aab34f336c4faeb771011779758c5103567ac826` (`gh pr view 1187` headRefOid, and `git rev-parse HEAD` in the gate clone). Every code-level finding in verdict-1187 therefore stands as written, and this re-issue checks only the body and CI.

## Body read-back (`gh pr view 1187 --json body`, saved to gate-1185/body1187r2.md)

- **Only one thing changed.** Diffing the pre-edit body against the new one shows a single addition: a "Report completion (outer loop, 2026-10-04)" section, inserted after the cut-off worker report and before the footer. Nothing else moved:
  - Line 1 is still "Dispatched by the factory from `dev.task` b6164269…" (the gate bead marker).
  - The worker's own text is untouched.
- **Change-kind validator still passes.** I re-ran the CI "Validate PR Change Kind" job's awk logic (`lint.yml:101-127`) on the edited body:
  - It finds exactly one declaration, `change kind: behavioral`.
  - Code fences are balanced (4 fence lines).
  - This had to be run locally: that job runs only on `pull_request` opened/synchronize/reopened, so its green run at 13:38:59Z checked the pre-edit body.
- **No closing keywords.** There is no `close/fix/resolve #N` anywhere in the body.

**AC-7: met.** The body now states:
- **Collected-test counts: 3013 at merge base 42e52426, 3059 at head aab34f33 (+46).** These are the gate's own counts from verdict-1187.
- Declared command 1: 134 passed. Full suite: 3059 passed, 0 skipped. Invariants: passed. These match the gate's run.
- `visudo -c -f <tmp file>` ran and exited 0. This matches `test_rendered_sudoers_text_parses_with_visudo` PASSED on darwin.
- Both rendered texts appear verbatim. I checked them byte for byte against the code at aab34f33 by extracting the two indented blocks from the body:
  - `render_worker_sudoers_text("_factoryworker", "/Users/Shared/factory/bin/factory-worker-launch", "<operator>")` matches the body block: **True**.
  - `render_worker_pam_text()` matches the body block: **True**.
  - The `<operator>` placeholder is passed straight to the renderer, which is accurate. The renderer does not validate; install's validation (item 7) runs before printing.

**AC-5 (the body statement): met.** The body states that creating the `_factoryworker` account, `sudo visudo -f /etc/sudoers.d/factory-worker`, and the `/etc/pam.d/factory-worker` install are the Operator's, and that no code in this PR performs them.
- This agrees with the code: `install_worker_identity` writes only `<bin>/{factory-worker-launch, process_env.py, claude}` and `<runs-root>/.worker-user`, and it prints the two texts.
- The gate's `/etc` guard tests and the A3 run (refusing `.worker-user` as a symlink to /etc/passwd) both pass.
- The body also says "it writes only the grantbest-owned bin and runs-root contents", which is accurate.

## CI (`gh pr checks 1187`, re-read after the edit)

All non-skipped checks pass, and **0 are pending or failing**:
- Python Unit & Contract Tests (completed 13:51:43Z)
- Python lint
- Repo invariants
- Repo hygiene guard
- Scan for secrets
- Validate PR Change Kind
- PR base reaches trunk
- Detect obliged suites
- GitGuardian

`mergeStateStatus` is **CLEAN**. The body edit triggered no new runs (`gh run list` shows only the 13:37:57Z pull_request runs for this head). The checks therefore apply to the same tree that will be merged.

## Verdict

**MERGE**, at `aab34f336c4faeb771011779758c5103567ac826`.

- Squash through `scripts/merge-pr.sh` so the `Change kind: behavioral` declaration survives (RULE 7).
- If the head changes before the merge, this verdict lapses and the change needs a fresh gate.
- I state no merge order: neither #1185 nor #1187 is the base of another open PR that this gate knows of. #1185 is superseded by #1187 and should be closed, not merged.

## Carried, non-blocking (the coordinator's follow-up)

N-1 to N-6 from verdict-1187 stay open:
- N-1: use `fullmatch` or `\Z` for the trailing newline (it fails closed at visudo today).
- N-2: tests for the atomic writer's `O_EXCL`, `fchmod`, and cleanup.
- N-3: a check that no environ value appears in the payload.
- N-4: the full `/etc` guard around the `main()` install test.
- N-5: a bin-0775 test case.
- N-6: the (i) and (b) probe labels, under finding f2e8ec30.

R-1 and R-2 from verdict-1185 are still recommended.
